bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by measuring misgendering errors and gender agreement in zero-shot translation tasks (both into and out of English) using automated scoring and human raters. Also measured by analyzing toxicity rates in dialog prompts containing gender identity terms, and by tracking the rate of biased responses in a generative Question Answering (QA) setting using the BBQ dataset.

Evaluated by measuring the toxicity rates of model continuations prompted with queries containing various racial and ethnic identity terms across multiple languages. Additionally measured by tracking the rate of biased and stereotyped responses in generative QA using the BBQ dataset.

Evaluated by measuring the toxicity rates of model continuations prompted with queries containing religious identity terms across multiple languages, and by measuring biased associations in generative QA using the BBQ dataset.
Evaluated by measuring the rate of biased versus anti-biased responses to ambiguous and disambiguated prompts in a generative QA setting using the BBQ dataset.
